name: Hinge corporate homepage by hinge.co
description: A warm editorial corporate page built on a cream canvas where tiny plum eyebrow labels sit above oversized serif headlines in asymmetric two-column compositions. Rhythm comes from alternating bands — cream editorial sections, a near-black testimonial band with a slider, a cream careers section with a photo strip bleeding off the right edge, then a merged dark press band and footer. Documentary-style candid photography, pill buttons, and hand-drawn oval-and-arrow annotations in aubergine give it a human, print-magazine quality rather than a product-marketing feel.
